# Publishing

<!-- This document is generated by Lattice. Edit the source specs, not this prose. -->
<!-- owner: LATTICE-DOC-008 -->

Explain how generated documentation and the Todo demo are built and published.

## Release and publishing notes

- `LATTICE-DECISION-049`: The GitHub Pages deployment workflow builds the root Lattice registry docs and the standalone Todo example docs during deployment, validates and audits the root registry, validates the Todo registry, verifies rendered outputs are current, assembles the generated root docs at the Pages site root and the generated Todo site under pages-site/todo, uploads that assembled site as a Pages artifact, and deploys it with the official GitHub Pages deployment action. Rendered site output remains out of version control.
- `LATTICE-DECISION-052`: The package version is bumped to 0.8.0 for GitHub publishing preparation, Todo demo GitHub Pages deployment, the generated documentation light/dark theme toggle, and DESIGN.md-based default documentation styling.
- `LATTICE-DECISION-053`: The package version is bumped to 0.9.0 for documentation-oriented Graphviz profiles, generated docs sidebar accordion navigation, component script cache busting, and Todo graph artifacts.

## Documentation publishing

The GitHub Pages deployment workflow builds the root generated Lattice docs at the Pages site root and the Todo example site under `todo/`, then publishes them from an assembled Pages artifact. Rendered site directories remain ignored by git.

- `LATTICE-DECISION-049`: The GitHub Pages deployment workflow builds the root Lattice registry docs and the standalone Todo example docs during deployment, validates and audits the root registry, validates the Todo registry, verifies rendered outputs are current, assembles the generated root docs at the Pages site root and the generated Todo site under pages-site/todo, uploads that assembled site as a Pages artifact, and deploys it with the official GitHub Pages deployment action. Rendered site output remains out of version control.
